title: Accept PostgreSQL-equivalent timestamps in Maker-GTD atomic transitions
author: agent:/root

originalRequests.text: Ок, расставь проблемы по приоритетам и давай их по очереди решать.

scope.goal: Resolve the first and highest-priority verified issue: valid Maker-GTD Paper full fills are rejected after PostgreSQL rounds persisted timestamps to microsecond precision while the atomic transition validator truncates the caller timestamp.
inScope: Maker-GTD Paper atomic full-fill and expiry timestamp equivalence at PostgreSQL microsecond precision.
Focused regression coverage for the two observed timestamp shapes where PostgreSQL rounds the final sub-microsecond digit upward.
Preservation of every non-timestamp order, fill, position, strategy-run, execution-source, state, and linkage guard.
Required contract validation, focused tests, affected build, independent semantic review, context/history bookkeeping, commit, and push.
outOfScope: Production database mutation, historical backfill or repair of the two already expired orders, deployment, service restart, configuration change, or Live order action.
Maker-GTD queue-delay optimization, WebSocket reconnects, OKX/reference/order-book transient failures, and log retention/volume; these remain later problems in the ordered queue.
Any change to Maker-GTD strategy decisions, price calculation, TouchNoDepth evidence rules, stake sizing, expiration, Paper/Live classification, or the closed ordinary-Paper exception.
Any relaxation of immutable order fields or atomic transition state/concurrency checks other than timestamp equivalence at PostgreSQL storage precision.
scope.periodOrFilter: All Maker-GTD Paper atomic transitions using PostgreSQL timestamptz values; production evidence is limited to the two exact rejected orders 9152ef50-bdee-4144-a198-c68432f524d8 and dd4b98c6-31a3-42ce-82dd-8a4527e0d73c observed on 2026-08-27 UTC.
scope.firstVerification: Compare the validator implementation with exact read-only production created_at_utc and raw accepted_at_utc values for the two rejected orders, under BEGIN READ ONLY and statement_timeout=15s.

requirements.text: Fix the highest-priority Maker-GTD fill-loss defect before proceeding to the remaining verified problems.
acceptanceCriteria: A pending Maker-GTD order whose caller timestamp and persisted PostgreSQL timestamp represent the same stored microsecond passes the immutable-shape transition check and can be filled atomically.
The exact observed shapes 2026-08-27T05:59:33.1706318Z persisted as 2026-08-27T05:59:33.170632Z and 2026-08-27T05:59:33.3761549Z persisted as 2026-08-27T05:59:33.376155Z are covered by focused tests.
Timestamps that resolve to different PostgreSQL microseconds remain unequal.
All non-timestamp immutable order fields and all execution-source, lifecycle-state, fill, run-link, position-concurrency, and atomicity checks remain unchanged.
No production data or runtime state is changed by this task.

verification.command: dotnet test tests/PolyCopyTrader.Tests/PolyCopyTrader.Tests.csproj --no-restore --filter "MakerGtdPaperAtomicRepositoryTests|MakerGtdPaperLifecycleIntegrationTests" with TEMP/TMP and all outputs under the active marked D:\CodexTemp run
verification.expected: The upward-rounding regressions pass, distinct stored microseconds remain rejected, and existing Maker-GTD atomic/lifecycle tests pass.

verification.command: Build the affected solution/project, run git diff --check, validate the requirement contract in WorkingTree and staged modes, and obtain independent semantic review.
verification.expected: Only PostgreSQL-precision timestamp equivalence and its focused tests change; no other Maker-GTD semantics are altered.
